name: Hideaway in Boston's North End-"Little Italy"
description: Hang your hat for a while in this secluded space in the heart of Boston's North End off the Freedom Trail.  Refreshing alternative to the hotel scene. Enjoy a unique cultural experience during your stay in this distinctive Italian enclave steps away from restaurants and shops.
host_about:
Let me know what brings you to Boston and what your interests are and I will do my very best to enhance your experience and make your stay in one of America’s most distinctive, charming, and authentic  urban neighborhoods unforgettable. I can most likely send you to at least one place you would never find on your own. I am a former Boston concierge, and local attorney and I hope you take me up on my hospitality advice and don't need any legal advice during your visit to Boston lol--but if you do, your stay with me includes a free legal consultation! 
My guests have access to the very best restaurants, café’s, bakeries, pastry shops and Italian import stores in all of Boston and they are steps from Girasole.  Many Italians have names for their homes to make their sense of arrival and time spent there more enjoyable. Girasole is the Italian word for “Sunflower” but the literal meaning of Girasole in Italian is “turns to the sun.” It is my pleasure as your host to turn you toward what are the brightest, best, and most Italian of experiences that are available in Boston’s Little Italy. Inside Girasole there is a list for you to make your wandering around the neighborhood more purposeful so that you can run into the best life has to offer during your stay.  
Ciao!

name: Angel’s room in Boston
description: Nice clean (and just repainted) bedroom available in 4 bedroom apartment on the third walk up floor or a three family home. Bathroom and kitchen are shared with the other (mostly long term and phenomenal) guests. :)
host_about:
Hi there, 

Thanks for looking up my listing, I hope you like what you see. 

I currently host in Providence, RI. My home is in a diverse and historic neighborhood. 
The home was built in 1910, it is large, welcoming and clean. 
It  has 3 stories, 6 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms & multiple common areas. Plenty of room to socialize if you wish so, or to keep to oneself if preferred. 
Whatever you do, please be kind, clean and considerate. 

I typically spend my week days in Boston and my weekends in Providence. When not in Boston or Providence, I can be found on photo assignments around New England or playing with pups! When not playing with pups, on assignments or hosting, I may be found roaming the the world. My favorite part of the world is South East Asia (I've spent multiple Winters in Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Japan, China, Myanmar, India, The Philippines and Indonesia to name a few ;)). More recent trips have taken me to Guadeloupe, Panama, Colombia and various other Central and South American countries. I grew up in Europe and speak French, Spanish and English and understand, or have notions of, a few other languages. I love discovering new cultures & meeting new people. 

I started hosting in 2016 and I’m loving it and  the chance to meet & host people from all corners of the world and walk of life! 

Your comfort & happiness under my roof (and out of the home) during your visit are very important to me; I always thrive to please my guests and, hopefully, surpass their expectations whenever I can! :) 

I adore pets and occasionally swing by with a furry friend or two. I allow up to two pet guests at a time. Please do not book with me if you have allergies or do not enjoy sharing your home with pets. I may or may not have furry friends during your visit. 

It is important to me that my guests are clean, kind, mature, considerate, respectful and friendly. No party, no loud anything and no smoking at the home please. Music/musicians and fun conversations are always welcome on the other end (but not expected). 

I look forward to hearing from you and hopefully hosting you soon; don't hesitate to reach out or ask anything. :)

description: My home is located in the ethnically diverse community of Mattapan, and is approximately 1.5 miles away from the bustling and trendy neighborhood of Lower Mills in Dorchester. host_about:
I am a father of two young boys (ages 10 and 6yrs), and I work in the holistic health field as a practitioner and educator. I travel frequently with my boys and, sometimes, I travel solo when continuing my studies with my teachers and mentors. It is in these cases that Airbnb particularly serves my interests. I like sports of all kinds, any music with a soul, and locally produced food, art, and products of all kinds.
The thing I most can't live without is hot water with lemon in the morning. Other than that, I might go so far as to say that I NEED fresh eggs, chips & salsa,  a craft beer or two, and a pillow under my head and another on my chest. As a guest, I like to think I'm fairly low maintenance and try to offer more to my hosts than what I require of them. Either way, I am happy to be a joiner or lock myself away in isolation.

Like nowhere else, Beacon Hill revels in the city’s storied past as it brilliantly scribes its future. One of the finest luxury hotels in Boston, The Whitney celebrates this remarkable exchange, drawing from its unique place to bring a rare essence and irreplaceable spirit to every guest touch-point. Within the hotel, discoveries are enriched with the lure and lore of Beacon Hill – with riffs on long-standing architectural details and nods to the modern makers that made this place – creating a connection to here, so the experience feels freshly-minted, time and again, and guests truly appreciate where they are, in this memorable place.

Thatch's Co-Living units are designed, built and furnished for those who are looking for flexible living.

Why commit to a 1-year lease, pay to move, pay a broker, buy furniture and spend precious time moving and getting settled if you aren't sure whether you'll be here for a year or not?

Thatch houses a number of college students, graduate students, traveling medical professionals.

All utilities are included! Contact us with any questions!
host_about: Thatch is an ever-evolving hospitality management company that specializes in co-living, hotels and apartment-hotels for short and long stays. Founded in 2010, Thatch's goal is to make Boston more accessible by providing innovative housing and hotel concepts at prices and on terms that put the value in hospitality back where it belongs - with the guests. We do this by stripping out non-essential services and amenities - like daily room cleaning and on-site food and beverage - and by centralizing our staff. In exchange, Thatch guests are afforded privacy, independence and more room in their travel budgets. Simple. Flexible. Functional. That's Thatch.

name: Cozy apartment in the lively heart of Boston
description:
Perfect to explore Boston through this 1.5 Bed apartment. Great for 2 people, a 3rd guest can take the sofa that’s designed to be the same size as a single bed. Located in North End/ Little Italy, incredible location in the heart of Boston.
Literally steps to many restaurants & bars! Delicious treats are just downstairs at Bova’s bakery, open 24/7.

I travel a lot, and I have lived in 5 countries across 3 continents so far. Otherwise reading, cooking, running, and biking around Boston are the things I love doing.
I hope you’ll like my apartment where I live when I am not travelling. It’s a great story for me as it represents what I value the most, people, friendship and community. They helped me furnish and decorate it for me and my guests. It’s also a reflection of my great experience in Boston so far and with the locals here.

name: Hotel Ivy Boston Common - Queen Room
description:
Stay in a restored 1877 landmark in downtown Boston, in a comfortable queen room. Perfect for solo travelers or couples who plan to spend more time out exploring than hanging out in the room.

Just steps from Boston Common and within walking distance of Tufts Medical Center, the Theater District, shopping, dining, and public transit. Ideal for guests who need fast, reliable access to the city’s core whether for appointments, patient support, work, or exploring Boston car-free.
host_about:
Hi, I'm Allan, Hotel Ivy's resident raven. I spend my days perched above Boston Common, collecting neighborhood secrets and helping travelers fall in love with Boston.

A few things about me: I appreciate a good ghost story. I know where to find the best cannoli in the city. Edgar Allan Poe lived near here, and I like to think we'd have gotten along.

Whether you're here for Freedom Trail adventures, Fenway nights, or simply the perfect cup of coffee, I'll point you in the right direction.

host_about:
We have been providing vacation rental apartments for over 10 years across the East Coast. We are known for our distinctively furnished apartments in popular locations, and for our attentive service. You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more. 

We offer an assortment of short-term apartments in sizes ranging from a studio to three bedrooms that are fully furnished with all the comforts of home. Our local staff meticulously prepares your apartment before your arrival, and we offer 24 hour assistance for any emergencies after business hours. When you arrive at your apartment, the beds will be made, towels and bath amenities will be stocked in the bathrooms, and the coffee maker will be set up in the kitchen with some sample coffees, sweetener and creamer (teabags too if that is your preference) to start your morning off properly. If you’d like to cook a meal, the kitchen is stocked with dishes, cutlery, glassware and pots and pans. The living room is set up with a TV and cable channels, and the Wi-Fi router password and instructions will be prominently displayed so you can get connected quickly. You can also make local and toll-free phone calls at no charge. 

Please contact us to confirm the exact availability of the apartment you are interested in. We’d love to host you (and your family) for your vacation or business trip.

name: Brand New 2 BR | 1 BA in So. BOS #1
description:
Completely Brand New Construction | 2 BR | 1 BA condo that features private deck, spacious living room with brand-new open kitchen with high-end appliances, high ceilings, brand-new hardwood floors throughout, and central air conditioning!

Private parking behind the building is available for an additional $30 per night.
host_about:
I live in the Back Bay and I'm happy to accommodate any unique requests. 

Our properties are available to business professionals seeking short-term corporate housing and families visiting Boston area hospitals.  Please inquire about our special rates for those associated with Shriners, MGH, BWH,  BIDMC, and Mass Eye and Ear. 

My large family are all long-time Boston residents, and most of the members still own apartments from when they lived in downtown Boston.  All of my condo's are owned by members of my family.

Prior to my current job at an investment consulting and advisory firm, where I focus on identifying top-tier real estate managers for our clients to invest in, I worked for a small firm managing a Saudi Prince's hotel investments across North America and Europe.  We managed his interests in the Four Seasons and Fairmont, as well as oversaw his investments in several trophy properties, most notably, NYC's The Plaza; Paris' Four Seasons Hotel George V; and London's The Savoy.  I have taken the same approach we took at my previous firm to managing our personal real estate investments, by providing exceptional service combined with fantastic accommodations in prime locations.

If you stay with us during the summer months (typically available mid weekdays from the middle of June to Labor Day), we'd love to take you out on our 50-ft yacht for a complimentary afternoon sail and lunch (catered by a restaurant / bar we own) around the Boston Harbor (schedule and availability permitting and limited to guests 16 years and older).

Also feel free to inquire about special rates on massages at Bodywaves - a business my father runs on Hanover St. in Boston's Quincy Market / Faneuil Hall area.

host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

I also love being outdoors especially riding my bike around town or walking my very friendly small dog, Henri.  He is hypoallergenic and he does not shed.  He lives on the second floor but if you met him you'd want him to visit you.  Henri is adorable and lovable!  He is like a teddy bear.

host_about:

You’ll find that our rates are quite reasonable. If you're looking for a safe, comfortable place with fabulous amenities and Wi-Fi (we know you need the Wi-Fi!) in the Boston MA area, Washington DC, Miami FL or very close to NYC in Jersey City or Hoboken, we'd love to host you. Many of the buildings where our apartments are located feature amenities such as beautiful lobbies, 24 hour front desk staff, fitness centers, business centers, recreation rooms, indoor or outdoor pools and whirlpools. If you are traveling with children, some buildings offer playgrounds (many buildings are near public playgrounds as well) or indoor playrooms. Depending on the location, you can stay for just a few days, a week, a month or more.

description:
Four bedrooms, two bathrooms, in-unit washer and dryer, and enough space for the whole group to actually spread out. This is the kind of apartment that makes a long trip feel easy, everything you need is already here, and Roxbury's best is right outside the door.

Seven guests, one space. No compromises.
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

name: Bohemian Paradise | Easy Access to All of Boston
description: Welcome to Boston! Perfect for families, groups, or business travelers, our space combines comfort and convenience in a vibrant neighborhood. Enjoy off-street parking, easy access to public transit, local dining, and popular attractions like Franklin Park Zoo and the JFK Library.
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.

name: Mature & Private Abode For The Family
description:
Welcome to a comfortable, ground-floor apartment designed for real stays. From the moment you arrive, you’ll notice how easy it is to settle in—natural light, clean finishes, and a layout that feels calm and practical. Whether you’re visiting Boston for work, family time, or an extended stay, this home offers the space and amenities to make your time here feel effortless.

If you have any questions before booking, feel free to send a message—we’re happy to help.
host_about:
I graduated college in 2017 with a chemistry degree. During college, I picked up a part time job as a houseman in my school’s hotel, less so for the money. More so to look busy. It was initially meant to be a past time, but one particular night left a mark I never forgot.

The job required me to assist the housekeepers. I was the grease to a well-maintained machine. Take off the bed sheets, remove the used soaps and towels, and empty the trash. You do that to every room. Simple right?

It was the last night for an opposing school’s football team and my manager needed someone to clean up after them and then prepare the rooms for the next working day.

I showed up and cleared every room assigned to me. I thought nothing of it and went back to my dorm. The next day, I went back to work on my regular shift. 

To my surprise, everyone came up to me to thank me for making their day a hundred times easier. I was happy for a moment. But then I scratched my head thinking to myself, “you all know that I’m getting paid for this right?”

But then it dawned on me. I was looking at this experience through broken glasses.

Hospitality is as much a human experience for the guests as it is for the people who make that experience worthwhile. 

That day has inspired to me to strive to make every experience worthwhile. My goal is to facilitate wonderful experiences for people around the world. Hopefully, hosting on Airbnb will be the catalyst for my guests to make fun, happy, and joyful memories.
